audience: For planners and supply chain leads
title: Small ripple at the shelf, *big* whip upstream
subtitle: How a 5% swing in sales becomes a 50% swing in orders. Illustrative numbers.

stages.name: Shop shelf
stages.desc: Real sales move about 5% week to week

stages.name: Distributor
stages.desc: Orders in big batches and loads up at month-end

stages.name: Bottling plant
stages.desc: Plans from orders, not sales, and adds its own buffer

stages.name: Preform and sleeve supplier
stages.desc: Hears the loudest, least true signal of all

takeaway: Bullwhip ratio = swing in orders ÷ swing in real sales. Above 1, you are adding noise.

author.name: Hammad Ulhaq
author.role: Head of Supply Chain · 20+ yrs FMCG & Beverages
